name: Shichikashuku (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shichikashuku town emblem in white: a stylised flying bird with swept-back wings.
history: Municipal flag of Shichikashuku, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in September 1966.

features.role: Shichikashuku town emblem — a stylised flying bird with swept-back wings
